about: Stand-in pictures for trial cards that have no art yet (Sprint 8, package 7). Each card shows the picture of another card in the page's own art until the art lane makes its own. The card's ID on its face stays its own.

CAP-130.why: an observer with binoculars behind sandbags, watching a valley: a prepared observation post

CAP-131.why: light infantry behind a village wall with an anti-armor launcher: fighters defending their own town
